find_triplet_sum: find a triplet in an array that sums to a given target value using a hash set approach
run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to find three numbers in an array that add up to a specified sum
test_triplet_finder: test the triplet sum finder against multiple parameter sets and compare results with the gold solution
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses a set-based two-pointer approach to find triplets summing to a target
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to return the triplet values instead of printing them directly
